notes:
**CHR-1062 — Use Cases tab, mapping view, pools and dialogs** (epic CHR-1060). Status: drawn, design re-review approved, awaiting Christian's approval. The design follows the build here (experiment branch `artisign-usecases`). Build tickets: CHR-1066 (blocked by CHR-1065). Decided with ADR-010 (Christian, 2026-11-16): a use case's `status` is only `draft | ready` (maturity of the spec); `priority` and the status `implemented` are removed everywhere; humans create, edit and delete use-case data in the preview dialogs as built, also in cloud mode; tool names stay as built (except get_use_cases → list_use_cases, CHR-1070).

## What it is
A fourth top-level view **Use Cases** (Screens / Design System / Board / Use Cases), entered from `app-shell.tab-usecases`; its topbar is `uc-topbar`. The tab is optional: a project without a `usecases/` folder behaves exactly as before and only shows `usecases-empty`. Inside the tab a sub-nav **Use cases | Personas | Data objects** in a 296px left panel; main column scrolls.

## Screens
- `usecases-list` — landing: search, filters (facet counts), sort (Group A–Z · Title · Status), grouped virtualized tree, selected detail; `usecases-list-sort-menu` — the sort menu open.
- `usecases-detail` — base flow, full length; `usecases-detail-variant` — variant as a diff + full-width Coverage section.
- `usecases-mapping` — flow next to the mapped screens.
- `usecases-personas` — user pool; `usecases-data-objects` — data-object cards.
- `usecases-empty` — empty project guide.
- Overlays (create / edit / delete): `usecases-edit-dialog` (use case), `usecases-edit-dialog-variant` (its Variants section, reached from + Variant), `usecases-delete-confirm` (More menu → Delete use case), `usecases-edit-dialog-persona`, `usecases-dimension-dialog`, `usecases-generate-dialog`, `usecases-object-dialog` (data object).
- Reverse entry in the Screens tab: `app-shell` Context panel, section "Use cases" (use cases whose steps map to the open screen; hidden when none).

## Editing paths (ADR-010: all as built)
- **Use case:** + (list) / New use case → `usecases-edit-dialog` in create mode ("New use case", Save = "Create use case"); Edit → edit mode; + Variant → the same dialog with a new empty variant appended and focused (`usecases-edit-dialog-variant`). Delete: detail header More (`more_horiz`) → menu with one item "Delete use case" → `usecases-delete-confirm`.
- **Persona / dimension / data object:** create and edit in their dialogs; edit mode has **Delete** at the left of the footer, which turns the footer into an inline confirmation: message "Delete <name>? Nothing is repaired: use cases that still name it keep a warning." (warning tone) and the buttons "Keep it" (autofocus) and "Delete <name>" (danger). References become warnings, nothing blocks.
- After every write a toast reports the result: "Use case saved." / "Use case deleted." / "Persona saved." … (auto-hides after ~2 s); with warnings it stays and lists them.

## States (all as built; placement and copy are binding)
- **List loading:** while a page loads, the tree shows a row "Loading…" (ui-2xs, tertiary, row height) at the end of the loaded rows; the first load shows only that row.
- **List page error:** a row in the tree "Could not load more: <message>" (ui-xs, warning colour) with a link button **Retry**; nothing retries by itself.
- **No result:** below the result line, a status paragraph (ui-sm, tertiary, padding xl/lg): "No use case matches these filters." when filters or search are active, otherwise "No use cases yet.".
- **Detail placeholder:** main column, centred box (min-height 240, tertiary): "Loading…" while the detail loads; "Select a use case." when nothing is selected; "No use cases yet." + button **New use case** when the folder exists but holds none.
- **Detail gone:** same placeholder with "This use case no longer exists." (the id from the URL or a deleted case); other load errors show the server message there.
- **Unreadable files:** toast "Some use case files could not be loaded." with up to 5 file warnings listed and "… and N more"; stays until dismissed (×).
- **Toast placement:** sticky at the top of the main column, margin lg/3xl, raised card with `chrome-shadow-float`, bold first line, dismiss icon button right.
- **Mapping frame loading:** each frame box shows a plain `chrome-field` fill at its final size until the render arrives; pins and outlines appear only after the frame is measured.

## Shared visual language
- **Status** (`uc-status`): Draft (dashed, hollow dot) or Ready (accent). No priority anywhere.
- **Mapping scope, always in words.** Target chip (`uc-target-chip`): Element / Screen / Stale; generated node ids get a warning line. The chip never overflows: it is capped at its container, the screen part truncates and the node id stays whole.
- **Mapping view frames.** Frame label: step numbers (`uc-frame-no`), screen id, one `uc-scope-chip` per scope (Element / Screen / Stale / Unstable). `uc-pin`: element outline + numbered pin; whole screen = border + tint + "Whole screen" chip; unstable = dashed; stale screen = "Screen not found" frame. Selected step = primary label bar, never an outline round the frame. Click a frame → open that screen in the Screens tab.
- **Data change:** before → after `uc-data-card`s. **Variant diff:** Changed / Added / Removed / From base. **Coverage:** full-width section, gap columns amber, "Suggest variants for <id>" prompt.
- **Warnings never block** (amber). Hard save rules: use case = at least one input and one output with an example, every variant has a title and a condition, overrides are a JSON object; persona/dimension/data object = name or label present, id lowercase kebab-case, no duplicate field/value ids. Every input or output row that names a data object needs an example with at least one key; an empty example is a shape error and blocks Save like the others (use-case spec v1.2 §11). Errors disable Save and show the first one in the footer.
- **Dialogs** are native `<dialog>` + `showModal()`, labelled by the title, header/footer fixed, body scrolls, dirty forms ask before discarding.
- **Form controls are native** (CHR-1097): closed lists are a native `<select>` with plain text options (`uc-select`: data object, step actor, trait value, field type); free text with suggestions is `<input list>` + `<datalist>` (`chrome-field`: group, persona role, step screen, step element). No avatars or rich labels inside selects. A value that does not resolve is `chrome-field warning`.
- **Persona avatar** colour/emoji is persona data (`--avatar-color`), not a token.

## Placeholders (empty inputs; neutral, no private sample text)
Placeholders show the shape of a value, never a step target: an example names data-object fields, not screens or nodes (CHR-1097).
- Use case: title "Map a step to a screen element", group "mapping/elements", tags "mapping, design".
- Inputs and outputs: data object = native select, first option "Data object…"; from/to "Use case editor"; example `status: ready`.
- Steps: action "What happens", screen "screen", element "element id". Data change: data object select as above, before `status: draft`, after `status: ready`.
- Variant: title "Large project: map from the list", id "from the title".
- Persona: role "Designer", goals "Find the screen a step maps to", description "Designs screens and writes use cases for them.".
- Dimension label "Project size". Data object name "Mapping", enum values "draft, ready".

## Shell and tokens
New tokens `typography.ui-heading` (20px) and `typography.ui-md` (14px). `shell-topbar` (all variants) and `app-shell` gained the Use Cases tab. Colours go through `--chrome-*` from `chrome-light.*`; dark not drawn. Base viewport 1440 wide; long views drawn at full scroll length. Folding `uc-topbar` into `shell-topbar` and a shared `uc-dialog` pattern for the repeated dialog shell are follow-ups (tracked in CHR-1067), not part of this ticket.

## Sample content
Artisign's own use cases, personas (Dana, Pablo, Coda, Dex, Sol, plus generated ones) and data objects. artisign/artisign is public: no sample data from other projects.
